cams.name: Hood Canal Communications Tower Cam (Union)
cams.shows: 🔑 THE OLYMPIC CAMERA. Elevated tower above Union looking NW across Hood Canal at the Olympic front range. Sees the actual skyline, so it reads the deck height directly: cloud banked in the valley with peaks above it is visible as undercast rather than inferred from 850 hPa. Fetch-verified 2026-10-24, frame was 0 min old, ~310 KB, timestamp burned in.
cams.note: Camera sits low but LOOKS AT high terrain. That makes it far more useful than an equally low cam pointed at a road. Judge the peaks in frame, not the weather at the camera.
cams.source: hcc.net tower-and-water-cams page, harvested via browser 2026-10-24. Not in any WSDOT feed.

cams.name: US 101 at Mt Walker MP 301.5
cams.shows: Hood Canal highway only. 🔴 The ONLY Olympic cam found and it sits ~5,400 ft below Ellinor and Townsend. Gray here is routinely undercast with clear summits above. Never let it veto an Olympic summit forecast.

gaps: No WSDOT camera looks at any Olympic summit. Nearest to Ellinor is Bremerton at 23.4 mi, sea level. WSDOT has nothing on Hood Canal at all.
